lines.2: 「Everyone, Inori has something urgent to do, so she says this period is self-study.」
lines.8: 「If we're noisy, we'll bother the other classes, so let's study quietly, okay?」
lines.11: 「Heh... Yoppi looks cute when she's troubled.」
lines.16: Everyone appeared to be studying seriously for the moment.
lines.17: 「This part is proper. Which means whoever starts the noise after this is the root of all evil.」
lines.18: And then the camera captured the decisive moment!
lines.20: Perhaps out for a flight, Mr. Tsuchinaga entered through the window.
lines.21: 「Very well. Listen to me, creatures that crawl upon the earth.」
lines.22: 「I met a beautiful American woman who was lost earlier. I kindly and gentlemanly showed her the way, and she kissed me in thanks. Heh heh heh.」
lines.23: 「Impossible! Are you saying I rank below even a bird!?」
lines.24: 「No way. That's a lie. Show us proof.」
lines.27: 「No! Now that it has come to this, I shall tell you every detail of my cute and cool romance!」
lines.29: And after that, it turned into the usual chaos.
